scenarios.title: Auth logins rejected after flag flip

topologies.note: Every agent reports straight to the investigator in round 1.
Agents report to an IncidentCommander, which spends one trace check on the most-repeated cited claim, drops it if refuted, and forwards the rest in round 2.
Claims pass agent to agent, one hop per round. Hops can drop citations; an accused self-protective relay rewrites the accusation.
